## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated; `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run type-check`, `npm run knip` pass
- [ ] UI changes: `npm run test:e2e` passes (no accessibility violations in light and dark mode)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency – or it is justified, permissively licensed and passes `npm run check:deps`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, tracking or third-party requests introduced
- [ ] No `v-html`, `eval` or new inline scripts (Content-Security-Policy)
- [ ] User-facing texts in English **and** German
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated where relevant
